description: This file defines the RowLevelOperation interface for representing row-level data source operations like DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE in Apache Spark, including methods for obtaining scan and write configurations, and metadata attributes.

classes.name: RowLevelOperation
classes.description: An interface representing row-level data source operations such as DELETE, UPDATE, and MERGE, with methods to configure scans, writes, and retrieve metadata.

classes.name: RowLevelOperation.Command
classes.description: An enum defining the types of row-level commands: DELETE, UPDATE, MERGE.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a description string for the row-level operation.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns the specific SQL command (DELETE, UPDATE, MERGE) being performed.

methods.name: newScanBuilder
methods.description: Creates a ScanBuilder to configure a Scan for this operation, with options.

methods.name: newWriteBuilder
methods.description: Creates a WriteBuilder to configure a Write for this operation, given write info.

methods.name: requiredMetadataAttributes
methods.description: Returns metadata attributes needed for the operation, defaulting to an empty array.
